kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننغرز (form VII)
# نَنْغَرِزُ (nanḡarizu) /nan.ɣa.ri.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# نَنْغَرِزَ (nanḡariza) /nan.ɣa.ri.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# نَنْغَرِزْ (nanḡariz) /nan.ɣa.riz/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
